text:
Nina Park: Heads up  let's lock the API contract for the "effective routing" preview used in saved queries. Need minimal fields + clear caching hints.

Ravi Patel: Agree. Minimal response shape should be: effective_model, fallback_model, trigger (quota|latency|manual), last_evaluated_ts, cost_delta_usd, stale (true/false). Keep it JSON-only.

Jorge M.: UX note: show last_evaluated_ts on the saved query card and a small "stale" dot if > 24h. Users get confused when preview doesn't match actual later.

Kai L.: Implementation constraints: preview API will be hit a lot if we call on hover. Propose: POST /console/saved-query/preview with body {saved_query_id, route_id, session_id, preview_only:true} and with response header X-Cache-TTL. Cache TTL default 30s, configurable by feature flag.

Ravi Patel: Also require an opt-out flag per-save: pinned_to_model versus pinned_to_effective. If pinned_to_model we'll return the model_id saved and avoid preview calls. Default should be pinned_to_effective for now.

Nina Park: Important: "pinned_to_model" must be explicit at save-time. If a user pins to model, UI should show a lock icon and tooltip "Exact model pinned; routing ignored".

Jorge M.: For telemetry please emit event quickview.routing_preview with fields: saved_query_id, route_id, session_id, effective_model, fallback_model, sample_rate, cost_delta_usd, cache_hit. Keep event size small.

Kai L.: Sampling plan: deterministic by route_id hash at ingest to avoid bursts. env var PREVIEW_SAMPLE_PCT default 1%. We'll include sample_rate in responses so frontend can attribute. Example:
```
// deterministic sampling
const samplePct = process.env.PREVIEW_SAMPLE_PCT || 1
const keep = (hash(route_id) % 100) < samplePct
```

Ravi Patel: Rate-limit preview endpoint by route+team to 5rps default. Also require auth scope console:preview.read.

Nina Park: UX: in the Save modal add two-line helper copy under the toggle: "Show live routing previews: we'll fetch the current routing decision when you view this saved query. Turn off to avoid additional preview calls." Default on.

Jorge M.: Edge case: saved_query created in a different region/model catalog. API should return region_hint and model_alias (not internal ids) so frontend can map to display names.

Kai L.: For cache invalidation: when routing policy config changes for a route, publish a routing-config-change event that includes last_changed_ts; preview API will mark cached responses with stale=true if last_evaluated_ts < last_changed_ts.

deploy-bot: preview-api service rollout scheduled: canary=5% routes for 24h, then 25%, then global. CI: 0 failures, 1 lint warning.

Ravi Patel: One more: telemetry naming convention: quickinsight.preview.v2 — include a small schema version on the response body to support future fields.

Nina Park: OK owners:
- @Ravi implement API + auth + sampling header.
- @Kai add cache header and routing-config-change hook.
- @Jorge add stale indicator and copy in Save modal.
- I'll own rollout dashboard (preview QPS, cache_hit%, stale_rate, pin_usage).

Jorge M.: I'll drop a Figma with the lock + stale badge by tomorrow morning.

Kai L.: I'll open the PR for deterministic sampler and default env var.

Ravi Patel: I'll mock the endpoint so product can test UX without infra.

Nina Park: Great. If anyone hits blocking questions ping me or post here. :thumbsup:
